interpretation: Exploratory development comparison; selection fixed by the pre-results plan and full-author-VI addendum. Report both rules. These small-run MSE differences do not establish optimal tuning or general superiority. Full-paper batch8 is the independent evaluation.

config.fitting_policy: DCS: fresh-batch reverse KL, seed 42, gradient-norm cap 10, no coordinate/CDF clipping. SCS: unchanged author VI, fixed base batch, seed 0, coordinate clip 1000, no gradient clipping. Both use Adam 0.01; fitting budgets and costs are recorded per family.
config.target_note: Analytic multivariate-t radial law; the normal-CDF sign skew leaves this law unchanged.
config.tuning_note: Every method receives the same separate warmup-transition budget. DCS-RWM and DCS-BW use acceptance-target 0.234 dual averaging. Reflected BW retains its ball-movement pilots without a geometric step ceiling of 2. DCS-Billiard calibrates its own production kernel using bounded squared changes of physical log(1+norm), including zero after rejection. SCS uses acceptance-target 0.234 dual averaging; this follows the paper's general acceptance guidance, not the fixed h=0.1 used in its skew-t experiment. The final pilot state and selected step initialize production; all steps freeze before sampling. VI off still calibrates proposal steps while keeping R=1, centre=0 and deformation=0.
config.time_scope: Equal per-chain sampling time includes first-third burn-in, every transition and all-state radial estimates and unthinned scalar capture for ESS. VI, separate step calibration, compilation, synchronization waits, ESS computation and file/report generation are excluded and recorded separately. All methods use JAX full-state scans.
config.reference_policy: Analytic Student-t radial references; no coordinate-reference simulation

selection_protocol.rule: This pre-results addendum supersedes the reduced-VI-on part of study_plan.json for default selection: use this full-author-VI on pair and the VI-off smaller pair. Retain acceptance only if both MSEs are lower in both pairs; otherwise fixed0.1. Publish all reduced-VI results too. Fresh full-paper batch8 evaluates the choice.
